claim_text: Andreas & Günther have introduced seven definitions of actual causation.
The definitions of actual causation are classified into three different types: factual difference-making, counterfactual difference-making, and regularity-based.
The paper discusses the most recent definition of actual causation, which is factual difference-making.
The paper derives empirical scaling laws for domain-specific LLM compression.
Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across a growing range of domains.
The scale of LLMs poses deployment challenges in applications where latency and cost constraints are critical.
